Description: Water trickles through a ring of ancient stone basins, each one lined with pale moss that filters the spores from the air. Someone built this place as a refuge a long time ago, and it still works.

Replies.ReplyText: Pay the shrine tithe and bathe in the basins.
Replies.SsText: The cold water washes the spores from your wounds. You emerge refreshed and whole.

Replies.ReplyText: Boil the moss into a restorative tonic.
Replies.SsText: The tonic comes out clear and potent. You bottle several doses for later.
Replies.FlText: The brew boils over, scalding the party.

Replies.SsText: You rest for a while, listening to the dripping water. It is peaceful.
